jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: Full Stack Engineer Nuaav Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India 1 hour ago 180 applicants See who Nuaav has hired for this role Apply Save Report this job Direct message the job poster from Nuaav Candida DSouza Candida DSouza Senior Talent Partner @ Nuaav | Ex-Infosys | HR 30under30 Jombay | Finding Needles in Tech Haystacks Since 2021 Job Description &#8211; Senior AI-Native Full Stack Engineer Company: Nuaav Location: India / Remote / Hybrid Experience: 4&#8211;7 Years Employment Type: Full-time Company Overview Nuaav is a boutique technology consulting firm focused on delivering innovative, scalable, and secure data engineering and AI solutions. We partner with corporate clients to drive impactful change through specialized expertise in product engineering, data systems, AI/ML, and user experience. Our services emphasize personalized attention, agility, and quality, enabling clients to confidently transform and grow in evolving business environments. Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on AI-Native Full Stack Engineer with strong expertise in modern frontend and backend technologies, combined with proven experience building AI-powered applications and intelligent systems. The ideal candidate is an AI-first engineer who can design, develop, and deploy scalable applications while leveraging Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI frameworks, and AI-assisted development tools. This role requires strong end-to-end engineering ownership, from building responsive user interfaces and scalable backend services to integrating AI models, developing intelligent workflows, and deploying production-ready solutions. We are looking for someone who has built real-world AI-native products , rather than someone whose experience is limited to consuming third-party AI APIs or using AI coding assistants. Key Responsibilities Full Stack Engineering Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, high-performance full-stack applications. Build modern, responsive frontend applications using React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript. Develop robust backend services using Python (FastAPI/Django) and/or Node.js (Express/NestJS). Design and integrate RESTful APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures. Work with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis. Own complete feature development, from architecture and frontend implementation to backend integration, testing, and production deployment. AI-Native & Generative AI Engineering Design, build, and integrate AI-native capabilities into enterprise-grade applications. Develop production-ready applications leveraging LLMs such as OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, and other commercial or open-source models. Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including document ingestion, embeddings, vector search, and contextual retrieval. Develop AI agents, multi-step reasoning workflows, and tool-calling systems using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent technologies. Implement AI-driven automation, conversational interfaces, intelligent assistants, and workflow orchestration. Integrate AI capabilities into frontend experiences, including streaming responses, conversational UIs, real-time interactions, and human-in-the-loop workflows. Implement model evaluation, prompt optimization, guardrails, monitoring, and cost/performance optimization to ensure reliable AI applications. Design secure integrations between LLMs, enterprise data sources, APIs, and external tools. AI-Assisted Development & Engineering Practices Actively leverage AI-native development environments such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and MCP-based tooling to accelerate engineering workflows. Apply AI-assisted development practices across code generation, debugging, refactoring, testing, and documentation while maintaining engineering quality. Build reusable components, establish development best practices, and contribute to technical architecture decisions. Develop unit, integration, and automated tests to ensure application reliability. Collaborate with product managers, AI engineers, designers, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into working solutions. Cloud & Deployment Build and deploy cloud-native applications on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. Work with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, serverless technologies, and cloud infrastructure. Ensure application security, scalability, observability, and production reliability. Troubleshoot performance bottlenecks across frontend, backend, and AI inference layers. Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 4+ years of hands-on software engineering experience with strong full-stack development expertise. Proven experience building and deploying AI-native or Generative AI applications in production . Strong frontend expertise in React.js, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. Strong backend development experience with Python and/or Node.js. Experience designing REST APIs, backend services, microservices, and integrating third-party systems. Strong working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and NoSQL technologies. Practical experience integrating LLM APIs and implementing AI-powered application features. Hands-on experience with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and AI orchestration frameworks. Understanding of agentic workflows, tool/function calling, and AI application architecture. Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure. Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, Docker, testing frameworks, and modern software development practices. Hands-on familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or MCP integrations. Strong debugging, problem-solving, communication, and end-to-end ownership skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience developing Agentic AI systems or multi-agent workflows using LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar frameworks. Knowledge of vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS, or pgvector. Experience implementing LLM evaluations, monitoring, guardrails, and production observability. Familiarity with structured outputs, function calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and AI tool integrations. Experience with WebSockets, streaming APIs, and real-time AI-enabled interfaces. Exposure to AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or managed AI infrastructure. Experience developing enterprise SaaS products, AI platforms, or intelligent automation solutions. Understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, and secure handling of sensitive data. Experience working in agile, fast-paced product engineering or consulting environments. What Makes You a Strong Fit? You are equally comfortable building sophisticated frontend interfaces and architecting reliable backend systems. You have personally built and shipped AI-powered applications , not just experimented with LLM APIs. You understand how to move AI solutions from proof of concept to scalable, production-ready products. You actively use AI-native development tools to improve engineering productivity without compromising code quality. You take ownership of entire features and can independently solve complex engineering problems. You enjoy working at the intersection of software engineering, AI, and product innovation. Why Work at Nuaav? Work on cutting-edge AI-native, Generative AI, and Agentic AI applications. Gain hands-on exposure to enterprise-scale product engineering and cloud technologies. Collaborate with experienced engineers, AI specialists, and technology leaders. Be part of a fast-growing boutique consulting environment that values innovation, agility, and technical ownership. Opportunity to build impactful AI-driven products and contribute to next-generation intelligent systems. Interested candidates can share their profiles at candida.dsouza@nuaav.com Website: www.nuaav.com Show more Show less Seniority level Mid-Senior level Employment type Full-time Industries Technology, Information and Internet, Information Services, and IT Services and IT Consulting Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at Nuaav by 2x See who you know

Save Report this job Job Description Role purpose Implement, test and support well-defined slices of X3 modernisation while developing strong X3 domain knowledge and safe engineering habits. X3 context Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics. The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes. Required Technical And Domain Skills Strong software engineering experience in modern programming languages such as Rust, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Python, Java, or C#, with a proven ability to build, test, deploy, and operate production-grade services. Solid foundation in software design, object-oriented and distributed systems principles, API-first development, automated testing, debugging, source control, CI/CD, and Agile delivery practices. Required understanding of distributed systems, including service-to-service communication, event-driven architectures, scalability, resiliency patterns, fault tolerance, asynchronous processing, observability, and data consistency trade-offs. Experience designing and consuming REST, GraphQL, and event-based integrations, with strong understanding of API contracts, versioning, backward compatibility, and secure service interactions. Experience working with relational databases and document databases, including data modeling, performance optimization, reliability, migration, and operational considerations. Familiarity with cloud-native engineering practices, including containers, orchestration platforms, infrastructure automation, observability, secure software supply chains, and operational readiness. Hands-on experience with containerisation and Kubernetes. Practical experience with modern web application development using React and TypeScript or equivalent modern dynamic UX frameworks, including component-based architectures, responsive and accessible user experiences, state management, browser diagnostics, and automated UI testing. Ability to learn and work effectively within Sage X3 business processes, metadata-driven architectures, extensibility models, modernization initiatives, and SaaS transformation programs. Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across distributed global engineering teams and contribute to technical design discussions and code reviews. Modern platform skills for this role Implement and test service/API contracts and integrations in the assigned discipline; follow secure CI/CD, identity/secrets and telemetry patterns, and contribute compatibility, upgrade and rollback checks. Build hands-on container or IaC skills when required by the owned service, using team-supported paths. Preferred Skills Commercial ERP, manufacturing, distribution or finance experience, including L4G/4GL or Progress 4GL. React, automated API testing, telemetry, batch processing or migration tooling. Practical use of AI coding assistants with human review and regression checks. Experience And Qualifications Typically 2+ years of professional software development, or equivalent practical experience. Degree, diploma or apprenticeship in computer science, engineering or a related discipline is desirable. Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications. Expected outcomes / success measures Owned work is delivered to agreed acceptance criteria with useful tests and no avoidable regression. The engineer builds confidence in X3 domain knowledge and contributes to safe modernisation decisions. Defects, risks and support issues are surfaced early with enough evidence to act. Learning, review feedback and delivery estimates become more accurate over time. Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role’s owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant. Key stakeholders and collaboration model Works with Senior and Principal Engineers, Automation, Product, Architecture, Security, Cloud Support/L3 and Customer Services. India-based delivery is integrated with distributed squads and planned Europe/North America overlap. Sage behaviours / leadership expectations Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Asks good questions, honours commitments, learns from feedback and keeps quality visible. Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible. Key Responsibilities Core accountabilities and decision ownership Implement features, fixes, APIs, components or migration assets from clear designs and acceptance criteria. Write maintainable code and automated tests, participate in review, and keep technical documentation and operational notes current. Learn X3 processes, metadata, Xtrem/X3 architecture and the effect of changes on customers, partners and upgrades. Use CI/CD, observability and local diagnostics to find problems early; escalate uncertainty with evidence. Contribute to refactoring, automation, accessibility, performance and reliability improvements within the squad. Decision ownership: Implementation choices within agreed patterns, test coverage for owned changes, and prompt escalation when requirements, customer behaviour, security or rollback are unclear. Common capability baseline All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level: Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role. Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need. Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities. Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths. Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence. Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership. Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate. Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerisation and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.
